about: Prediction ledger (operator 11/07): before a result lands, each forecaster writes a concrete expected outcome. Scored after. Over time this shows, with numbers, whether Claude is too pessimistic and Argon too optimistic, and on which kinds of question each is reliable. Add Argon's forecasts verbatim as the operator relays them.

items.test: X3 trend-hold 'both' (floor at opening stop + off after +15 bp peak), session replay screen
items.expect: screen DROP or a delta within +-10 bp/day; does not reach confirm
items.resolved: 2026-11-07: X3 'both' screen was DROP (+8 bp/day, 40% of days) and it did not reach the sweep's confirm stage.

items.expect: small positive day delta (cuts the -70..-80 bp tail) but fewer than 60% of days better
items.resolved: 2026-11-07: floor_only was exactly 0 on the screen AND on the 10 confirm days; 'small positive' was wrong (it never fired).

items.resolved: 2026-11-07: fixed lock50 lost -7.5 bp/day on the 10-day run and -0.5..+0.1 bp/trade in the simulator; 'DROP' held (the run used the confirm days, not the screen stage).

items.resolved: 2026-11-07 11:31: FAIL on absolute net (-9.4 bp, t -2.11); lifts -0.5 vs both controls (about zero). The earlier lift value was not recorded, so 'moves toward zero' is only half checkable.

positive: the logical candidate to ship is both + lock50 without step01 (Argon, relayed by the operator)

items.resolved: 2026-11-07: 'both' was NEGATIVE (-11.9 bp/day), not 'positive but small'; I had it positive, wrongly. Direction wrong.

items.expect: +0.4 to +1.0 bp/trade (+8 to +20 bp/day); solidly positive on event days, near zero otherwise
lock50 adds 0 to +0.3 bp/trade; 'both' alone may beat both_lock50
items.resolved: 2026-11-07: lock50 added +0.25 bp/trade on top of 'both' (-1.03 -> -0.78), inside his 0 to +0.3 range; but both_lock50 (-7.5/day) beat 'both' (-11.9/day), so 'both alone may beat both_lock50' did not happen. Scored on the stated numeric range.

items.resolved: 2026-11-07: both -1.03 vs both_lock50 -0.78 bp/trade: a +0.25 difference, inside +-0.3. (Per-day means differ more: -11.9 vs -7.5.)
